propositions: Extraction from free-form model replies to heuristic, allowing schema-valid decoys outside the intended payload to win; an explicit output channel (sentinel markers) makes payload location a stated contract instead of inference.
Current parser uses fence-wrapped blocks as a channel, but models wrap quoted JSON in fences, defeating the distinction between payload and incidental fence wrapping.

The marker extraction must handle line-anchored, non-nested marker pairing (OPEN...OPEN...END yields one block; OPEN...END...OPEN...END yields two, last wins) with reverse-order iteration to implement last-block-wins semantics independent of the selection pipeline's internal ordering.
A reply with no markers must fall back to the current schema-filtered full-reply selection pipeline byte-for-byte unchanged, so markerless and legacy model transcripts do not regress.

The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py contradicts the marker directive by instructing bare JSON; the retry must name the same markers as the first attempt to maintain a consistent fail-closed channel across both attempts.

A marker block whose content is invalid must raise (fail-closed) rather than fall through to pick a valid decoy outside the markers; an empty marker block (no content between markers) must also fail closed via the empty-text guard.
